# Nora Studio — Machine-Readable Intelligence Summary (llms.txt)
> Project: Nora Bot & Nora Studio
> Official Domain: https://vaztinix.dev
> Mission: The #1 Privacy-First All-In-One Discord Bot protecting every community that she encounters.

## Identity & Core Philosophy
Nora is an enterprise-grade, privacy-first Discord bot engineered to provide complete server infrastructure, automated moderation, community progression, and conversational companion intelligence without ever compromising member privacy.

Unlike traditional bots that log chat streams or sell server analytics to third parties, Nora operates under a strict **Zero-Access Architecture**:
- All message content processed for prefix commands, automod, or collaborative games is held strictly in volatile RAM and immediately discarded.
- Zero message hoarding or disk logging.
- Direct user sovereignty: Any member can run `/mycard` or `n!mycard` to inspect their data and permanently erase it with a single click.
- 100% data custody via self-hosting with zero telemetry sent home.
- Zero developer inspection backdoors.

## Key Feature Capabilities & Modules
1. **Adaptive Slowmode & Velocity Clamping**: Real-time traffic monitoring detecting message bursts and raid velocities, dynamically scaling channel slowmode (3s–10s) and decaying back to normal when chat cools down. Supports monitored channels and whitelisted role exclusions.
2. **Dual Command Routing**: Universal prefix execution (`n!`, `n?`, `@Nora`) and native Discord Slash Commands (`/`).
3. **Multi-Model Google Gemini AI Engine**: Multi-pool Gemini integration (Flash Lite, Flash Latest, 3.5 Flash, 3.8 Flash) with automated 10-second fallbacks for background events (Leveling, Starboard, Roasts, Cheers), multimodal vision analysis, and image generation.
4. **4-Tier Verification Suite**: 1-Click Agreement Button, Procedural Anti-Bot CAPTCHA, Reaction Emojis, and Roblox Account Linking with Group Rank synchronization.
5. **Leveling & Rank Card Studio**: Dynamic voice & text XP calculation, custom role reward multipliers, and customizable SVG/Canvas rank cards.
6. **Starboard Engine v3.0**: Dynamic star thresholds, tier emojis, webhook author embeds, channel ignore lists, and AI spotlight commentary.
7. **Collaborative Games**: Anti-cheat sequential Counting and collaborative One Word Story.
8. **Obsidian Web Dashboard**: Real-time server management interface at https://vaztinix.dev/dashboard.

## Self-Hosting & Cloning Rules
- Permitted: Non-commercial self-hosting for personal servers and educational study with full database custody.
- Mandatory: Retain all developer attributions to Vaztinix and the Nora Studio Team.
- Prohibited: Charging users, commercializing hosted forks, removing developer credits, or impersonating official Nora Bot services.
